description: This file defines the root layout component and app entry point for a Remix-run based React application. It imports layout and routing components, specifies link tags for styles and fonts, and renders the main outlet for nested routes.

methods.name: links
methods.description: Returns an array of link tags for preconnecting to fonts and linking to Google Fonts stylesheet.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: React component that provides the HTML structure, including meta tags, links, and styles, wrapping its children.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Root component rendering the nested route outlet.
